translations.web: Yahweh’s glory went up from the middle of the city, and stood on the mountain which is on the east side of the city.
translations.bsb: And the glory of the LORD rose up from within the city and stood over the mountain east of the city.
translations.kjv: And the glory of the LORD went up from the midst of the city, and stood upon the mountain which is on the east side of the city.
translations.asv: And the glory of Jehovah went up from the midst of the city, and stood upon the mountain which is on the east side of the city.
